text:
Noah (AE): VelaTech just sent back an order form with two asks: a 150k token/month POC credit for 2 months instead of an up-front discount, and a clause that we must accept a customer PO as the trigger for billing. They also want a clause saying we won't access customer keys (BYOK). Can we support?
Jia (SE): We can do 150k/mo credits applied as invoice credits. BYOK is workable but must document feature tradeoffs (snapshotting, cache warmup). I'll draft a short tech appendix for the handoff.
Asha (Sales Ops): Finance note: we require a PO before any production activation. If they demand DocuSign first, we need a billing-commencement contingency in the order form.
Luis (Legal): Don't change core MSA SLA values. For short POCs we prefer an addendum that states: POC term 60 days, temporary SLA 99.0% (if customer insists), liability cap equals fees paid during POC. We'll also add KMS appendix clarifying provider has no key access unless customer explicitly enables managed keys.
Noah (AE): Customer redline pasted: ```
- POC credits: 150,000 tokens/month for months 1-2 applied as invoice credit
- Commencement: Services begin upon DocuSign; PO will follow within 14 days
- KMS: Customer-managed BYOK; provider must not possess plaintext keys
```
Jia (SE): If they want services to start on DocuSign before PO, that's risky for billing. Technical workaround: we can enable a sandbox tenant with strictly throttled capacity until PO is received. Recommend we insist on PO or limit sandbox functionality.
Asha (Sales Ops): Proposed process: customer uploads PO to their procurement portal -> we ingest PO -> we send DocuSign envelope routing customer legal + customer procurement in parallel -> provider signs last. If PO can't be delivered first, we add: "Billing commences upon receipt of PO or 14 days after countersignature, whichever occurs first." Thoughts?
Luis (Legal): Prefer: "Commencement contingent on PO; if PO not received within 14 days of countersignature, Provider may suspend services and invoice for any usage at list rates." Keeps protection. Also add a short clause that credits apply only to base token units and not third-party add-ons.
Noah (AE): Customer asked about overflow pricing while credits exist (billing for overage). They want overage at 40% off list. Can we do that?
Jia (SE): 40% off list is heavy but for a 2-month POC acceptable. Need to define token metering: recommend UTC-month billing meter and explicit examples in order form.
Asha (Sales Ops): Routing: DocuSign template supports parallel customer signing (legal+procurement), then provider AE -> provider finance. Template id ord-2024-v2. I'll prepare envelope with placeholder PO and credit lines.
contract-bot: Action: created envelope draft using template ord-2024-v2. Fields: po_number, credit_line, overage_rate. Draft ID: drf-99021.
Luis (Legal): Also add termination right for both parties during POC with 7 days notice. Keep indemnities standard. I'll push redline to the shared drive: https://redwood-internal.share/contracts/vela-poc-redline.
Noah (AE): I sent the tech appendix to the customer (brief KMS handoff steps). They replied ok to sandbox but still prefer DocuSign-first. Asking us to shorten PO window to 7 days.
Asha (Sales Ops): If they want 7 days, get exec signoff for PO exception. Finance won't accept less than 14 days without approval. @Noah please confirm if customer can sign procurement in parallel; that would speed things.
Noah (AE): Customer agreed to sign procurement in parallel. They will try to upload PO same day. I'll update when it's in.
contract-bot: Envelope drf-99021 updated with po_number placeholder. Waiting for PO to autofill.
Asha (Sales Ops): Update: PO 46002145 uploaded and pasted into envelope. Sending for signatures now.
Luis (Legal): Final check complete. Accepted POC addendum with SLA 99.0% for POC term and liability cap equals POC fees. Proceed to sign.
Asha (Sales Ops): Envelope completed and countersigned. Sandbox activated with limited capacity pending KMS handoff.
Jia (SE): KMS handoff scheduled next Wed. I'll post the tech note and an internal checklist after the handoff.
Noah (AE): Closing: Deal moved to POC. Thanks all. :tada:
